newsitem.title: USA: FOB Gulf Grain-Corn steady to lower, soy offers up.
newsitem.headline: FOB Gulf Grain-Corn steady to lower, soy offers up.

text.p: U.S. FOB Gulf corn basis values were steady to lower on Monday while soybean offers rose, export sources said.
Wheat values were unchanged from Friday.
One U.S. exporter said floodwaters along the upper Mississippi River in Minnesota has created loading problems for some elevators, which contributed to the rise in soybean CIF values.
Rising river water and flooded rail lines will halt operations at some grain elevators in the Minneapolis suburb of Savage this week, grain company officials said.
